messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout v3.14 -> inference-service started (10% of traffic) on cluster-prod-us-west: https://deploys.redwood/rollouts/3099990001

maria (SRE): seeing a spike in 502s and a couple crashloops on inference-canary pods (index 0/1). HPA also scaled some replicas to 0 during the drain attempt.

jon (eng): logs show repeated failures allocating kv cache, then liveness restarts:
```
2026-03-17T15:02:10Z inference-canary-0 OOMKilled
stderr: Failed to allocate kv cache: out of memory
```

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Severity 2 alert triggered. Paging oncall: @lee

lee (oncall): Oncall here. Pausing rollout and putting feature-flag kill-switch on canary. Who can flip feature/canary-enabled -> false?

jon (eng): Flipped flag to false (feature/canary-enabled = false). App routed back to stable variant, traffic dropped to canary. Confirming rollback pause. :thumbsup:

maria (SRE): while investigating: cluster node drain in progress on node-abc. HPA for inference-canary has minReplicas=0 so during drain it scaled down remaining pods -> no healthy pods left and restart thrash once nodes rejoin.

cassie (product): any customer impact we should surface? Support shows ticket from Acme with errors beginning ~15:01 UTC.

sam (support): Confirmed. Support ticket #12345. Customer reporting intermittent 502s ~15:01-15:06. Escalated to success team and emailed customer with incident acknowledgment.

lee (oncall): Action plan: 1) revert canary to stable image (rollback) 2) enforce HPA minReplicas=1 for canary workloads and patch manifests 3) pause any node drains until we validate fixes. I'm executing rollback now.

jon (eng): Rollback command run:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-canary --to-revision=42 -n prod
```
Rollback initiated.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed successfully. Stable deployment serving traffic again.

maria (SRE): Postmortem notes (short): manifest shipped with hpa.minReplicas=0 for canary. During node drain autoscaler allowed scale-down to 0, causing restart thrash and 502s. Created PR #4823 to set minReplicas=1 for canary jobsets and add a pre-drain hook that prevents scaling or new rollouts during node cordon.

lee (oncall): Handoff: moving to eng-oncall for follow-up. I'll update the incident tracker and notify CS. Leaving at 3099990034. :white_check_mark:
